The reading theme for term three is Adventure & Misadventure. The books are available to collect in-store now! You can view the list of books here. Term fee is $30/term. events.title: Author Talk & Activities: Animal Force
events.description:
Come and sit around the (pretend!) campfire with author and speech pathologist Cerise Madsen and discover what your own unique Aussie animal force is these school holidays!
Join us for a magical hour inspired by Animal Force, a wildlife adventure packed with fun, danger and epic animal powers. Cerise will read a spellbinding excerpt from the book, then it’s over to you. Meet the animal heroes and characters from the story, learn about the real life superpowers of our Australian animals, choose your own animal force and bring it to life with a colourful craft activity. Along the way we’ll play fun camping word games, learn some fun key word signs for Aussie animals, and discover our own inner light. 
Perfect for curious kids 7+ who love stories, animals and a little bit of magic.
Bookings required. This event is $5/child, redeemable off any purchase of Animal Force before or on the day. Parents are welcome to drop off their kids and go-- staff members are blue card-certified.
